title: atomic.executor-card/1
description: Executor card of POST /v1/router/score (DECISION.md). The engine (decision_card_validate) and tools/decision/reference.py also check what JSON Schema cannot say: passed <= total, strings at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes (maxLength counts code points), and integral floats such as 188.0 (JSON Schema calls them integers, the engine rejects them). Unknown fields are allowed; the engine ignores them with a warning.

nonblank.description: A string with at least one character that is not a C0 control, DEL or space (card-v1 turns those into separators).

count.description: An int64 count. The bound is exclusive 2^63 because 2^63 - 1 is not a double: a validator that reads numbers as doubles would round an inclusive 9223372036854775807 up to 2^63 and accept 2^63, which the engine refuses.
